# Feature Specification

## Metadata
- Feature: `eval-oauth-login`
- Profile: `Simple`
- Status: `Approved`

## Problem Statement
- Users cannot sign in with an existing identity provider.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `AC-001`: Completing Google OAuth2 creates an authenticated session.
- `AC-002`: Cancelling consent leaves the user unauthenticated.
